title: National Salvation Booklet Entitled "Shanghai Youth"

page_data.en:
FM. 2
G. 55M-1-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
S.1, Special Branch, 8733Y
REPORT
Date September 14, 38.

Subject National Salvation Booklet entitled "Shanghai Youth"
(上海青年)
Made by Clerk Loh Wei-kong Forwarded by C. Crawford D.S.

* Realio
D 843

The Third Issue of the "Shanghai Youth," a
national salvation booklet, dated September 3, 1938, has
come into the possession of the Municipal Police. It
purports to emanate from the "Shanghai Youth Society
(上海青年社)," formerly known as the "Shanghai
Students' Federation (上海市学生联合会)"
(address unknown), and contains the following articles :-
(1) Japanese economic situation after one year's war.
(2) The prospects of situation in Europe.
(3) A little experience we gained during one year's
war of resistance.
(4) Letter box containing questionnaire and answers
on political problems in general.
(5) Reflection on the sale of National Flag in connection
with the "August 13th Anniversary."
(6) Activities of Chinese guerilla units.
(7) A letter to our distressed brethren during the
prolonged war of resistance.
(8) How to write composition.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

The first issue of this booklet dated May 10, 1938
was obtained during the course of raids conducted by the
Municipal Police at the end of July, 1938, in connection
with the publication of an anti-Japanese booklet entitled
the "Isolated Light" (Vide Special Branch Report of
August 1, 1938), while the second issue made its appearance
on July 1. Both copies are alleged to be published by
the Shanghai Students' Federation.

* 58677
FILE

Loh Wei Kong
Clerk
D.C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号............
S.1，特务科，8733Y
报告
日期：1938年9月14日。

主题：题为《上海青年》的救国小册子
（上海青年）
由职员罗伟公（Loh Wei-kong）编制，由C. Crawford 副督察转呈。

* Realio
D 843

1938年9月3日出版的第三期《上海青年》救国小册子已为工部局警务处所获。该刊物声称出自“上海青年社”（原称“上海市学生联合会”，地址不详），包含以下文章：
(1) 战争一年后的日本经济形势。
(2) 欧洲局势展望。
(3) 我们在一年抗战中获得的少许经验。
(4) 信箱：包含关于一般政治问题的问卷及答复。
(5) 关于“八一三周年纪念”期间出售国旗的反思。
(6) 中国游击队的活动。
(7) 致长期抗战中受难同胞的一封信。
(8) 如何写作作文。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科）

本小册子的第一期出版日期为1938年5月10日，系工部局警务处于1938年7月底进行搜查行动时查获，该行动与出版一本名为《孤光》的反日小册子有关（参见1938年8月1日特务科报告）；第二期则出现于7月1日。据称这两期均由上海市学生联合会出版。

* 58677
档案

罗伟公
职员
特务科侦探长
